GRAND AVENUE © FRANKLIN PARK, iLL. 60131 SERVICE BULLETIN GAME: Gun Fight Cocktail Table SUBJECT: Possible glass top breaking when using wrong length mounting bolts to secure top assembly. REMEDY: The front top assembly mounting bolt should be 3 inches in length. The two rear mounting bolts are 34 inches in length and should not be used in front. AD/r 4/14/76 Jor KIEW
